calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS m, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, sum(gross_amount) AS gross, sum(net_amount) AS net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_gross
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, w.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date, f.gross_amount, s.store_id, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB')
SELECT store_id, status, dispatch_date IS NULL AS no_dispatch, date_trunc('month', sale_date) AS sale_m, date_trunc('month', dispatch_date) AS disp_m, category='ZZ Test' AS test, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g
FROM web WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-10' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current, s.store_key, count(f.sales_line_id) n, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM dim_store s LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.store_key=s.store_key AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
WHERE s.valid_from <= DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.valid_to >= DATE '2024-08-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY s.store_id, s.valid_from

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT (s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL))
SELECT region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN net_amount END) AS aug_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN net_amount END) AS sep_net
FROM lines GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN business_date < DATE '2024-09-01' THEN net_sales_before_returns END) aug_net, sum(CASE WHEN business_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' THEN net_sales_before_returns END) sep_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND business_date < DATE '2024-09-01' THEN net_sales_before_returns END) aug_web, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND business_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' THEN net_sales_before_returns END) sep_web
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep, s.store_id=900 AS web, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT (s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL))
SELECT region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_incl_vat,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_incl_vat
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
